concerns.text: Missing task for Normal Mode Analysis (NMA) using PyVib. Spec FR-003 and Plan Constitution Check VI require deriving torsional variance via PyVib NMA on conformers. T013/T014a only describe generating conformers and calculating 'torsional variance' directly, omitting the mandatory PyVib step. This leaves the core metric undefined.

Tasks T050-T055 (Scaling Law Analysis) implement a new hypothesis (power-law, 'landscape') and metrics (beta exponent) not present in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-010) or plan.md. These tasks have no matching FR/SC in the spec, creating unvalidated work that cannot be measured against the defined success criteria (SC-001 to SC-006).

Missing explicit task requirement for 'exponential backoff' logic in T009 (required by Spec Edge Cases) and missing requirement to count/report 'protocol heterogeneity' exclusions in T010 (required by Spec FR-010 and SC-006). While T010 mentions 'protocol_metadata', it lacks the specific counting/reporting mandate.

Ambiguous coverage for FR-006 (FDR correction). T016 applies FDR to 'full set of 3 descriptors', but Plan/Spec restrict predictive modeling to 'dihedral variance' only. The task fails to clarify if FDR is applied to the diagnostic set (bond/angle) or only the predictive set, risking non-compliance with the 'N > 1' condition logic.

Stale tasks T000/T001 attempt to create `research.md` with hardcoded content. The plan indicates this file should be generated dynamically or via a script (T036/T037 pattern) to ensure reproducibility. These tasks conflict with the 'Re-plan' section which flagged them as failing verification due to missing artifacts.
